zh.title: 國防部偵獲共機4架次與共艦6艘 國軍嚴密監控
zh.summary: 國防部偵獲共軍4架次軍機與6艘軍艦；其中2架次共機進入西南及東部空域。
body: 國防部於9月14日上午對外發布最新共機艦動態統計。國防部指出，自9月13日上午6時起至9月14日上午6時止的24小時內，共計偵獲6艘共艦、2艘公務船，以及4架次共機持續在台灣海峽周邊進行活動。
根據國防部進一步說明的活動範圍，在上述偵獲的4架次共機當中，有2架次共機侵擾台灣西南及東部空域。
面對共軍機艦在台灣周邊海空域的活動，國防部強調，國軍均已運用任務機、任務艦以及岸置飛彈系統進行嚴密監控與應處。

en.title: Taiwan MND Detects 4 PLA Aircraft and 6 Naval Vessels Around Island
en.summary: Taiwan's Defense Ministry detected four PLA aircraft and six naval vessels around the island.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released its latest report on PLA military activity on September 14, 2026. According to the ministry, six PLA Navy vessels, two official ships, and four PLA aircraft were detected operating around the Taiwan Strait between 6:00 a.m. on September 13 and 6:00 a.m. on September 14.
Among the four detected PLA aircraft, two sorties entered Taiwan's southwestern and eastern airspace during the 24-hour reporting period, maintaining activity in the region surrounding Taiwan.

In response to the detected movements of the Chinese military aircraft and vessels, Taiwan's Armed Forces deployed combat aircraft, naval ships, and land-based missile systems to closely monitor and respond to the operations.
